meta.what: Weapon-tip path per kit x weapon family x melee clip. Read-only measurement from the GLBs (Blender 5.2 headless).
meta.source: assets/models/kit_<class>_male.glb, form_wolf.glb, form_bear.glb (main repo); IMPACT_FRAME from game/entities/entity_view.gd (attack-arcs worktree)
meta.coords: Godot model space: x = character's LEFT (+X), y = up, z = forward. Metres. Model origin = entity position.
meta.frames: impact_frame is IMPACT_FRAME (1-based, 24 fps). path[k] = tip at frame IMPACT+k, k = -4..+2 (clamped to the clip).
meta.tip: vertex of the weapon piece farthest from its hand bone in rest pose (weapons are skinned 100% to hand.R / hand.L). Forms: front-most vertex of each front paw and of the snout.

fields.sweep: PILOT CONVENTION: sign of the tip's x displacement from IMPACT-2 to IMPACT+1 (+1 = toward the character's left = counter-clockwise seen from above; 0 = under 0.10 m). Spin clips: sign of the body turn.
fields.sweep_fast: sign of x in strike_vec (the fastest 1-frame step inside IMPACT-2..IMPACT+1). sweep_ambiguous = it disagrees with sweep (weak or back-and-forth lateral motion).
fields.sweep_yaw_deg / sweep_yaw_conflict: signed yaw of the tip about the body's vertical axis over the pilot window; conflict = its sign disagrees with sweep (tip passes over/behind the head).
fields.type: from strike_vec: horizontal (>=50% lateral), overhead (>=50% vertical), thrust (>=50% forward), diagonal (no component reaches 50%), spin (body turns >=270 deg in the clip), static (tip under 0.15 m/frame around impact).
fields.vertical_dir: tip going down/up/level from IMPACT-2 to IMPACT+1.
fields.arc_deg: angle covered over IMPACT-4..IMPACT+2. arc_basis = yaw_body_axis (yaw about the body's vertical axis; horizontal and spin clips) or shoulder (angle swept as seen from the weapon arm's shoulder; everything else, and horizontal clips whose tip crosses the body axis).
fields.yaw_deg / shoulder_arc_deg / blade_deg: raw angles over IMPACT-4..IMPACT+2: signed yaw about the body axis, shoulder-subtended arc, rotation of the hand->tip direction.
fields.plane_tilt_deg: tilt of the best-fit plane of the strike path (0 = flat/horizontal swing, 90 = vertical plane).
fields.reach: max horizontal distance of the tip from the model origin over IMPACT-4..IMPACT+2; reach_at_impact / fwd_at_impact at the impact frame.
fields.h_min/h_max/h_at_impact: tip height above the ground (y). below_ground = h_min under -0.05.
fields.peak_speed_frame: 1-based frame where the tip moves fastest in the WHOLE clip; impact_off_peak = more than 2 frames from impact_frame.
fields.speed_into_impact: tip travel (m) from IMPACT-1 to IMPACT.
fields.body_turn_deg / body_fwd_at_impact: shoulder-line yaw over the whole clip; hips forward travel from frame 1 to impact.
fields.role: basic = the basic attack clip of that weapon; skill = clip chosen by skill shape (sweep, spin, finisher, flurry, claw, leap, charge, thrust) or slash_shot with a pistol; other = clip of another family (only reachable through SkillDef.clip).
fields.hand: main (hand.R) / off (hand.L, only when the off hand holds a one-handed melee weapon); forms: paw_r, paw_l, snout.
